rootCauseClusterSummary.name: Missing Fixture Auth Tokens
rootCauseClusterSummary.rootCause: Postman environment variables fixture_user_token and fixture_member_token unpopulated, resulting in missing Authorization headers on batches 1, 4, 5, 6, 7.

rootCauseClusterSummary.name: Task 17 Active Bank Guard Enforcement
rootCauseClusterSummary.rootCause: Folder 03-05 tests executed financial mutations before linking an active bank connection, correctly blocked by active_bank_required guard.

rootCauseClusterSummary.name: Empty GUID Variable Cascade (Model Validation 400)
rootCauseClusterSummary.rootCause: Empty GUIDs (destinationWalletId, sourceWalletId, linkedTransactionId, bankConnectionId) sent in request body due to failed upstream creations.

rootCauseClusterSummary.name: Unseeded Entity ID Cascade (404 Not Found)
rootCauseClusterSummary.rootCause: Downstream operations on wallets, transactions, legacy groups, or fund treasury received 404 because upstream creations failed.

rootCauseClusterSummary.name: State Assertion Cascade (Status 200, Value 0)
rootCauseClusterSummary.rootCause: Tests asserting balance > 0 or list count > 0 received 0 because upstream wallet funding / fund contributions failed.

rootCauseClusterSummary.name: Unseeded Fixture PIN Reset Token
rootCauseClusterSummary.rootCause: B1-02 PIN reset request passed unseeded fixture_pin_reset_token, rejected with 401 pin_reset_token_invalid.
